theorems.name: Submission.deformation_telescope_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (A B : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k), (∀ ν ω, A (ν + 1) ω = A ν ω + B ν ω) → (∑' ν, (B ν).mass) < ∞ → ∃ A' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, WeaklyConvergesOn A A' ∧ A'.mass ≤ (A 0).mass + ∑' ν, (B ν).mass ∧ (∀ (ν : ℕ) (Dν : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k), (∀ ω, Dν ω = A' ω - A ν ω) → Dν.mass ≤ ∑' μ, (B (μ + ν)).mass) ∧ ∀ F : Set (Eucl N), IsClosed F → (∀ ν, (A ν).support ⊆ F) → A'.support ⊆ F
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
